name: Disobedience To God
overview: Scripture reveals that disobedience to God often arises from misplaced desires and a failure to fully trust His commands, as seen when Adam and Eve ate the forbidden fruit because it was pleasing to the eye and seemed desirable. The account of Lot's hesitation to follow divine instruction to flee to the mountains, choosing instead a nearer city, illustrates human reluctance to fully obey God's protective guidance. Moreover, Moses' initial resistance to God's call and the Lord's anger at his excuses underscore the seriousness of resisting God's appointed mission. Lastly, the tragic consequence of Lot's wife looking back despite clear warning demonstrates the peril of disobedience and divided allegiance.
